source: adsb.lol (God's Eye View community ADS-B aggregation feed)
acquisition_method: Real-time HTTP GET query to REST v2 geographic bounding circle endpoint

geographic_coverage.airspace_description: Mumbai (VABB / BOM) FIR and surrounding Western India coastal airspace

fields.name: aircraft_hex_id
fields.description: Unique 24-bit ICAO aircraft transponder address in hexadecimal

fields.name: callsign
fields.description: Commercial flight callsign or radiotelephony callsign (whitespace stripped)

fields.name: registration
fields.description: Aircraft civil or military tail registration number

fields.name: aircraft_type_icao
fields.description: ICAO aircraft model designator (e.g., A320, B77L, B738)

fields.name: squawk_code
fields.description: Secondary surveillance radar 4-digit octal transponder squawk code

fields.name: emitter_category
fields.description: ADS-B emitter category classification code

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: WGS84 latitude coordinate in decimal degrees [-90.0, 90.0]

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: WGS84 longitude coordinate in decimal degrees [-180.0, 180.0]

fields.name: altitude_baro_ft
fields.description: Barometric pressure altitude in feet referenced to standard 1013.25 hPa

fields.name: altitude_geom_ft
fields.description: Geometric altitude in feet above WGS84 ellipsoid

fields.name: is_on_ground
fields.description: Flag indicating whether aircraft is operating on the airport surface

fields.name: ground_speed_kts
fields.description: Speed over ground in knots (nautical miles per hour)

fields.name: true_track_deg
fields.description: Direction of flight over ground in degrees clockwise from true north [0.0, 360.0]

fields.name: vertical_rate_fpm
fields.description: Rate of climb or descent in feet per minute

fields.name: position_age_seconds
fields.description: Latency in seconds since last geographic position report

fields.name: last_seen_seconds
fields.description: Latency in seconds since last transmission message received

fields.name: distance_from_center_nm
fields.description: Radial distance from Mumbai query reference point in nautical miles

fields.name: bearing_from_center_deg
fields.description: Compass bearing from Mumbai query reference point in degrees

fields.name: signal_rssi_db
fields.description: Signal strength indicator in dBFS from nearest ground receiver

fields.name: provenance
fields.description: Record-level audit trace containing source URL, query center, and pipeline timestamps

chain_of_custody: 2. Raw unmodified response stored in raw/aircraft_raw.json with acquisition metadata in raw/acquisition_metadata.json
3. Statistical profiling executed by scripts/profile_aircraft.py producing validation/profiling_report.json
4. Schema normalization and quarantine segregation executed by scripts/clean_aircraft.py
5. Data quality gates executed by scripts/validate_aircraft.py producing validation/aircraft_quality_report.json

limitations: Feeder Receiver Density: ADS-B data relies on community ground receiver volunteers; coverage drops in low-receiver or oceanic zones.
Temporal Snapshot: Dataset represents a discrete temporal query, not a continuous track history.
MLAT Precision: Multilaterated aircraft positions have variable horizontal dilution of precision compared to direct ADS-B.
Barometric Altitude Variations: Pressure altitudes reflect standard atmospheric datum (1013.25 hPa) and differ from local QNH or geometric altitude.
Transponder Disabling / Stealth: Military or non-equipped aircraft may not broadcast ADS-B signals or transponder codes.
intended_use: Evaluation of BHIV vNEXT MasterDB geospatial capabilities, data cleansing benchmarks, and airspace entity normalization.
transformation_summary: Extracted individual aircraft dictionaries from API response 'ac' container.
Standardized field naming convention to snake_case domain terminology.
Sanitized text whitespace and capitalized identifiers (callsign, registration, ICAO type, hex).
Enforced WGS84 coordinate boundary validation: latitude [-90, +90], longitude [-180, +180].
Converted numeric fields with type enforcement and NaN/inf rejection.
Separated 'ground' indicator string in altitude to boolean is_on_ground flag.
Quarantined non-conforming records with explicit root-cause diagnostic tags.
Preserved original aircraft identifiers and attached immutable provenance metadata.

masterdb_boundary_governance.governance_note: CRITICAL BOUNDARY: This dataset is a candidate ingestion asset. It is NOT registered in BHIV MasterDB, has NOT been canonicalized, and NO duplicate GIS master database or parallel spatial truth layer was created.
